messages.subject: Bee Survey using distance
parts:
Dear distance users..

I intend to study honey bee nest densities in a biosphere reserve in
South India. The bees belong to the Apidae group namely Apis dorsata,
Apis florea, Apis cerana & Trigonna sp. I would like to know if
anyone has used Distance for similar kind of study. Looking forward
to your suggestions in this regard. Hoping to hear from you all.

Regards

Sumin George
